articles.title: Sen. Adam Schiff says Pete Hegseth should testify on Starlink slowdown in Ukraine - NBC News
articles.description: Sen. Adam Schiff said that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth should testify before the Senate on the Starlink satellite limitations that disrupted Ukrainian military operations.
